additional_info.subject: RE: 0380670 - ID0380670-DC/Si-D/IL-[MP / ND 170000125] HMI Delamination CRM:00472000323
additional_info.body:
Dear Michele,
Regarding this ticket – it refers to an HMI fault under Q-feedback. As you know, there is now a new generation of HMI screens (GEN 3).
Today, we placed a large order to replace the faulty screens.
We decided to stop replacing GEN 1 screens with GEN 2, as the same fault existed in GEN 2 and we wanted to avoid performing the replacement twice.
We intentionally keep tickets of this type open, as they serve as proof for the warranty claim process to demonstrate that an issue was reported on time, preventing rejection due to expired standard warranty periods.
We expect the replacement process and ticket closure to take approximately 1–2 months, depending on when the new screens arrive in Israel and replacements can be completed.
For now, we will keep this ticket open to maintain the original opening date and to ensure we have a clear record of which HMI screens are faulty.
I will continue to keep you updated. This situation is not easy for us, as it directly impacts the productivity and reliability of our chargers.
Thank you for your understanding.
Best regards,
Orel
